CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_step_ok(o text, n text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select o = n
    or (o in ('new', 'awaiting_payment', 'awaiting_transfer', 'payment_reported', 'awaiting_delivery', 'sent', 'placed')
        and n in ('paid', 'cancelled', 'payment_reported', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'disputed'))
    or (o = 'paid' and n in ('confirmed', 'preparing', 'cancelled', 'disputed', 'shipped'))
    or (o = 'confirmed' and n in ('preparing', 'cancelled', 'disputed'))
    or (o = 'preparing' and n in ('ready_for_delivery', 'cancelled', 'disputed'))
    or (o = 'ready_for_delivery' and n in ('out_for_delivery', 'cancelled', 'disputed'))
    or (o in ('out_for_delivery', 'shipped') and n in ('delivered', 'disputed'))
    or (o = 'delivered' and n = 'disputed')
    or (o = 'disputed' and n in ('delivered', 'cancelled'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.profiles_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.is_privileged() and (new.role is distinct from old.role or new.email is distinct from old.email) then
    raise exception 'Role and email cannot be changed from the app.';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.so_step_ok(o text, n text, route text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select o = n
    or (o = 'pending' and n in ('accepted', 'rejected', 'cancelled'))
    or (o = 'accepted' and n in ('preparing', 'cancelled'))
    or (o = 'preparing' and n in ('ready', 'cancelled'))
    or (o = 'ready' and (n = 'cancelled' or (route = 'direct' and n = 'out_for_delivery') or (route = 'hub' and n = 'handover_pending')))
    or (o = 'handover_pending' and n in ('at_hub', 'cancelled'))
    or (o = 'at_hub' and n = 'consolidated')
    or (o in ('accepted', 'preparing', 'ready', 'handover_pending', 'at_hub', 'consolidated') and n = 'issue')
    or (o = 'consolidated' and n = 'out_for_delivery')
    or (o = 'out_for_delivery' and n = 'delivered')
    or (o = 'issue' and n in ('ready', 'at_hub', 'cancelled'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_live(p_store text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.stores s
    where s.id = p_store and s.status = 'approved'
      and (s.is_official or exists (
        select 1 from public.store_subscriptions ss
        where ss.store_id = s.id
          and ((ss.status in ('trialing', 'active') and ss.current_period_end > now()) or (ss.status = 'past_due' and ss.grace_until > now())))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.throttle(p_action text, p_max integer, p_secs integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not public.rate_hit(auth.uid(), p_action, p_max, p_secs) then
    raise exception 'Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.';
  end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.join_waitlist(p_email text, p_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_role text DEFAULT 'shopper'::text, p_country text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_interest text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'website'::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_email is null or p_email !~* '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$' then raise exception 'Enter a valid email'; end if;
  insert into public.waitlist(email,name,role,country,interest,source)
  values (lower(p_email), left(p_name,120), case when p_role in ('shopper','seller','both') then p_role else 'shopper' end, left(p_country,2), left(p_interest,200), left(p_source,40))
  on conflict (lower(email)) do nothing;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_seller_orders(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, order_id text, status text, route text, subtotal numeric, commission numeric, earning numeric, accept_by timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, customer_name text, customer_city text, customer_phone text, customer_address text, items jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select so.id, so.order_id, so.status, o.route, so.subtotal, so.commission, so.earning, so.accept_by, so.created_at,
    case when o.route = 'direct' and so.status in ('accepted', 'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered') then o.cust->>'name' else split_part(coalesce(o.cust->>'name', ''), ' ', 1) end,
    o.cust->>'city',
    case when o.route = 'direct' and so.status in ('accepted', 'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered') then o.cust->>'phone' end,
    case when o.route = 'direct' and so.status in ('accepted', 'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered') then concat_ws(', ', o.cust->>'street', o.cust->>'city', o.cust->>'state') end,
    (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'name', i.name, 'size', i.size, 'qty', i.qty)), '[]'::jsonb) from public.order_items i where i.seller_order_id = so.id)
  from public.seller_orders so join public.orders o on o.id = so.order_id
  where so.released and private.owns_store(so.store_id) and (p_status is null or so.status = p_status)
  order by so.created_at desc
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.on_signup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles(id, email, phone, name, country, dob, photo)
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    new.phone,
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'country',
    nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'dob', '')::date,
    nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'photo', '')
  );
  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_earnings()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare n int;
begin
  update public.ledger_entries set status = 'available'
   where status = 'pending' and kind in ('sale', 'commission') and seller_order_id in (
     select id from public.seller_orders where status = 'delivered' and delivered_at <= now() - make_interval(days => private.pol('payout_hold_days', 3)::int));
  get diagnostics n = row_count;
  return n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.support_guest_open(p_id text, p_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_topic text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_page text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_id is null or p_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,64}$' then raise exception 'Invalid visitor'; end if;
  if (select count(*) from public.support_queue where created_at>now()-interval '10 minutes')>300 then raise exception 'We are busy. Please try again shortly.'; end if;
  insert into public.support_queue(id,name,topic,page) values(p_id,left(nullif(trim(p_name),''),40),left(p_topic,60),left(p_page,120))
  on conflict (id) do update set last_seen=now(), status=case when public.support_queue.status='closed' then 'waiting' else public.support_queue.status end;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.support_tier(p_store text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select lower(pl.name) from public.store_subscriptions s join public.store_plans pl on pl.id=s.plan_id
    where s.store_id=p_store and s.status not in ('cancelled','canceled','expired','ended') order by s.current_period_end desc nulls last limit 1),'none') $function$
